title: Tentative agreement for public health nurses
subtitle: Brief special meeting after closed session; routine by-law and adjournment completed.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting on March 9, 2023. After meeting in closed session, councillors returned to open session to deal with a single item: a tentative Memorandum of Settlement for the Region's Public Health Nursing staff, who are represented by ONA Local 15.

Council approved the tentative settlement {{vote:m2}}. It covers July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2025 and is outlined in report HRC-LRE-23-001. A settlement of this kind sets the working terms for the region's public health nurses for the three-year period, which matters for the stability of local public health services.
Council then passed the by-law confirming the meeting's proceedings and adjourned shortly after 8:50 a.m. No declarations of pecuniary interest were made. The minutes record no other business.

decisions.detail: Council approved a tentative Memorandum of Settlement with ONA Local 15 for the Region's Public Health Nursing staff, covering July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2025, as outlined in report HRC-LRE-23-001.
